evals.prompt: Build me a grocery list for this week: pasta primavera https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/16385/pasta-primavera/ , chicken stir-fry https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/223382/chicken-stir-fry/ , and vegetable curry https://www.budgetbytes.com/vegetable-curry/
evals.expected_output: A deduplicated aisle-grouped list annotated with the full dish names, water/salt/pepper dropped, duplicates consolidated, plus a short summary of fetched/failed/dropped/consolidated counts.
expectations: scripts/extract_ingredients.py (or an equivalent JSON-LD parse) is used to pull recipeIngredient arrays
No output line contains plain water, salt, or black pepper
No two lines in the same aisle share the same normalized item name
Every line ends with a parenthesised dish annotation using the full dish name from the prompt
The summary lists how many recipes fetched successfully and any that failed with a reason

evals.prompt: Two recipes, one of them is dead: tacos https://www.example.com/this-page-does-not-exist-404 and lentil soup https://www.budgetbytes.com/lentil-soup/. Shopping list please, plain text.
evals.expected_output: Plain-text list from the working recipe; the failed URL is reported in the summary and contributes nothing; no fabricated taco ingredients.
expectations: The output is plain text with aisle headers on their own lines and no bullets
The summary names the failed URL and gives a reason
